method: The final PDFs were rendered with Poppler pdftoppm -png -scale-to 1150. All 30 pages were inspected in two full contact sheets; all 10 raster-different pages reviewed as a larger montage and critical ASP24 p11 / NGGroup p5 individually. Actual RGB pixels compared with the previous 65ff5d version: 10 changed, 20 pixel-identical. PyMuPDF checked every extracted text span against page rectangles: zero outside-page spans. This is integrator inspection, not independent human or assistive-technology testing.
observations: All final 30 pages accounted for: changed ASP24 2,5,7,11 and NGGroup 5,6,7,12,15,16; 20 identical in raster comparison at same Poppler scale.
Text inside page rectangles; no visually evident clipped table, heading, footer or unreadable chart. Original cover artwork preserved.
ASP24 p7 synthetic UAH 6570+10380=16950 and 2 x 305m=610m; p11 GA4 interpretation bounded.
NGGroup p5 URL path date does not prove revision, dBm ranges legible, automatic comparison MAY detect discrepancies; p6 theoretical E/P stated before plot.
NGGroup p7 literal invalid historical date retained; p12 DEPS Quattro-II anecdote attributed to prior review; R34 OPEN.
independent_pdf_acceptance: reports/hardening-pdf-acceptance.json (historical baseline only; current checks in exact report-artifact)
limitations: The historical PNG contact sheets under reports/rc3-review are not the current render; current per-page PNGs are retained in local handoff evidence.
External human PDF reading, VoiceOver, native Safari/iOS and published HTTPS checks are NOT_RUN.
veraPDF PDF/UA-1 PASS for current generated bytes in pinned CI is separate from visual assessment.
